name: PBQ at MSU 2024
information: Please note: The only events at this competition are 3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4 Blindfolded, 5x5 Blindfolded, and 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded. These events tend to be very boring for spectators, and we will not be having the normal speedsolving events that you're used to. If you are looking to compete in a speedsolving competition, considering registering for [Michigan Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MichiganChampionship2024), which is on June 29-30. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdlI0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f9b97cdd02309bd8b0ff92b40de315ef9ccaf564/PBQ%20at%20MSU%202024%20comp%20page.png)
